seoTitle: How to Add Wise to Stripe for Payouts (2026 Guide)
metaDescription: Learn how to connect your Wise multi-currency account to Stripe so you can receive payouts even without a local bank account. Step-by-step for 2026.
intro: If Stripe doesn't support a local bank account where you live, linking a Wise multi-currency account is one of the simplest workarounds. This guide walks through what you need before you start, how to add your Wise details inside Stripe, and how to confirm payouts are landing correctly. It's especially useful for freelancers and international businesses that rely on Stripe for payments but need a flexible way to receive the money.

steps.heading: Check the requirements first
steps.body: Before touching Stripe, make sure your Wise account is fully verified and supports the currency your Stripe payouts will be sent in. Having this sorted upfront avoids failed transfer attempts later.

steps.heading: Add your Wise account details in Stripe
steps.body: Inside your Stripe dashboard's payout settings, enter the Wise account information as you would a regular bank account. Stripe treats it like any external bank destination once the details are entered correctly.

steps.heading: Verify the account for smooth transfers
steps.body: Stripe will typically run a verification check on the newly added account. Completing this step is what unlocks reliable, delay-free payouts going forward.

steps.heading: Receive payouts into Wise
steps.body: Once verified, your Stripe balance will route to your Wise account on your normal payout schedule, letting you hold and convert funds in multiple currencies.

faq.question: Why would I use Wise instead of a normal bank account with Stripe?
faq.answer: Wise is useful when Stripe doesn't support a bank account in your country, or when you want to receive payouts in multiple currencies without extra conversion fees.

faq.question: Is there a delay the first time I connect Wise to Stripe?
faq.answer: Yes, expect a short verification period before payouts start flowing normally, since Stripe checks new payout destinations before releasing funds.

faq.question: Can freelancers and international sellers use this setup?
faq.answer: Yes, this method is specifically aimed at freelancers and international businesses that don't have access to a Stripe-supported local bank account.

faq.question: Do I need a business Stripe account to add Wise?
faq.answer: The core requirement is a working Stripe account with payout settings you can edit, plus a verified Wise account in a matching supported currency.
